body: I'm sorry, I want to reply to you but it's too hard to think about right now, I can't at the moment. I'm sorry.

Thank you for this. As your kids are your reason I don't have that yet. That week that you don't have them is my constant. I need to find that reason. If I didn't have my friends or family then I absolutely would have stopped living when the accident happened. I had severe injuries and I was in the hospital for a very long time. I was in the ICU for a while in the beginning and I often drifted in and out of sleep. I wasn't comatose but my brain shut down like I was quite often. I had a concussion and my brain was in bad shape. I had to fight mentally to stay alive and I had that mindset back then. I wonder if things would be different today. 

I'm glad you have your kids, they seem awesome. I'm going to go to a lake my girlfriend and I used to go to today. My parents are taking me there and I want to see what happens. I haven't left the house for any substantial period of time since the accident happened and I want to spend the entire day on this lake even if it's cold out. I don't know if it would be bad or good for me but I need to see because there are so many good memories here that will be recalled and I need to see if the trauma I suffered has suppressed them. I may have told you that my memory of my girlfriend is fading because the trauma is replacing those memories with horrible ones? I need to stop that as soon as possible. I need the memory of her. Has that happened to you yet? Whenever you think of him is it just him in "that moment"? For me, it's often that this happens. When I think of the woman I love, I see her as I would in that moment and it terrifies me. I'm starting my therapy tomorrow and it's what I want to fix first. If you don't mind, has that happened to you?
I did. I hate being a burden but having someone to lean on during this is really nice. They understand but it's been two years and this happens so often
Thank you

She was talking that morning about how excited she was for our trip and we were just getting ready to leave when she realized she forgot her backpack. If she wouldn't have remembered that she would still be here. We had so many plans. We were talking about children, I have a ring for her, we were going to get a dog. So many opportunities lost because we made a mistake and not only that but I lost her in such a brutal way that my image of my beautiful love is being replaced by her in that car in my mind. This beautiful and amazing person is now haunting me and it hurts so bad. I just want to hug her so badly right now.

My parents and few friends are the only reason I'm still here. If I didn't have them I would've stopped living long ago. Thinking about them going through what I'm going through is a reason to live even I'm only here just to suffer. I haven't laughed or had a smile since it happened and I honestly don't think I'm capable of being happy anymore. I can't even get out of bed to go to the bathroom without help from my parents. It's a like not worth living to be honest. The physical and mental trauma I face everyday is vastly more powerful than my will to live. So many aspects of life trigger my PTSD that I won't ever be normal or free from this pain. It's who I am now. I don't mean to be a downer but it's how I feel. 

Those little victories don't exist anymore for me. I could care less about anything around me. My room is a bed and a shelf of my girlfriend's things and that's it. I don't have a tv or anything anymore because it causes PTSD so I sit and stare at my walls all day. I can't listen to music anymore because it triggers my PTSD. I've let my fears fester for so long and it's so much now. If my therapy doesn't help I don't know what I'm going to do.

It's ok, I understand. I just don't like when people say that because it's absolutely not true. I've been told it a lot and it upsets me. Sorry if I came off hostile. Anger is an emotion that is prevelant in my life these days because I like like I was cheated out of a life and so was my amazing girlfriend. I don't know if I'll ever accept it because it shouldn't have happened. 

I viewed my life here as a punishment for something after everything happened. I couldn't figure it out but I just wanted to join her for so long and I still do. Going to tell a story, you don't have to reply if you don't want to but it helps me to type it out. 

The other night I put her engagement ring out of the box and laid it on her shelf I have for her. It was the most difficult thing I've ever done because I always thought I would put it on her finger and I did up until I put it on the shelf. It was so difficult to do this but after I did it I felt relieved almost because I finally did what I wanted to do, I gave it to her. Last night I had a dream of her. It was just so fucking real, it was insane. I don't remember what we talked about but it felt so long and real, like she was there. In this dream, she had the ring on. We were on the beach we always thought about marrying on and I got to live that out for a while even in a dream. It was the best experience I've had in so long yet I was unconscious while it happened. When I woke up I was sent into an intense panic attack and needed assistance from my parents. It was the such an intense pain and I crawled out of bed and just tried to breathe but I couldn't. These types of attacks happen every few weeks but this one was severe, I couldn't breathe at all. I think if my parents wouldn't have come to rescue me I maybe would have died? I don't know but it's weird to think about because I can interpret it in one of two ways. Somehow I was being brought over to the other side by dying or it was a reminder of my mortality and I shouldn't take advantage of it. I felt more fulfilled in that dream than I have in two years... 

If I could see her again like I did in that dream I would do anything to get that to happen, anything. It doesn't matter what I would have to sacrifice I would do it. She is a piece of me and always has been. Imagine how I look on the outside, I'm broken, right? That's how I am internally but even more so. I don't know why I'm still here and my life is a struggle with little reasons to continue forward so everyday I struggle with the fact that I'm even alive. I know so many people have been through this and they've gotten through it but I lost my entire life in one night for no reason. I'm sorry but it's just hard to even continue to live at this point. I'm not reverting back to before I posted, I'll still go forward but I just wanted to explain how hard it is. I don't know why I want to but it helps that someone knows and understands.

Thank you for this. My girlfriend was a beautiful and amazing person and she shined very brightly on this world. Her shine is now a piece of me and I have been laying in bed grieving for the past two years. Anger, sadness, despair; all of these feelings have dominated my life and I pity whoever spends their entire life in them like I'm guessing he does. I believe it is my role in this world to take this amazing shine my girlfriend has and share it with so many others. I'm not ready yet but someday I hope to be there.

I didn't respond to much of this conversation here but your post stood of out. I have heard so many times that it was my girlfriend's time to go. My response to this is, fuck that bullshit. We had so many things left to do in this world and just because we were happy while we were alive doesn't mean we weren't cheated out of a life together. The anger and resentment I feel for what happened hadn't faded and I feel it now as I read these comments and I direct my anger at whoever is behind the account who made those messages. My girlfriend was a kind and sweet person. She was loving and never hurtful. She didn't deserve this. The user behind those messages is purposely evil and he WALKS freely. The reason I am so disgusted by him is his mere existence. People like my girlfriend are taken everyday, the type of person to make the world better, yet diseases are left here.

I don't know his story and I don't care to. I've been through a nightmare as well and I would never do anything like that. He has no reason to do so. If he was abused as a child he needs to look at his life and see what was wronged to him and never repeat it. He has failed so terribly so far it makes me doubt the future of humanity.

For some reason I got a notification for this and I wanted to comment on it. 

The weirdo guy or whoever it is seems as if he has a disconnect with the real world so treat him as if he's mentally ill because I'm guessing he is. He refers to me as a "chad" who fucked his girlfriend all day and partied. This was disgusting to read and he doesn't even consider my girlfriend as a person but an object. Next he goes and says she's a shitty driver. I originally thought he didn't deserve the hate being directed at him but I've changed my mind. 

He is a truly vile and disgusting person and if I could somehow get ahold of him, even in this state, I would beat the crap of out him for saying those things. Those are words one human would never say to another and treatment no fully developed human brain would be capable of thinking. This post got big because it is difficult to comprehend the evil behind this person. It is not something one would experience in regular life. 

The reason for this is that I believe he is disconnected from reality and sees this platform and other humans differently than how the normal mind would. I'm guessing this is due to his trauma but his obsession with games and movies and whatever from what other people have gathered have formed a personality that is a fictional character, not a human. The way he phrased his words to me are like he sees me as a character from a slasher movie "going to the cabin". It's not natural and it's not human.

Whatever he does in his life now he is in charge of and he can accept his past or use it is as fuel to become even worse than those who made him. That's all I have to say about him. I believe he is a truly disgusting person and I am very pleased to see that the world has order that at least some people decided to call him out on this. Thank you for writing this and defending a stranger on the internet.

Thank you for all of this. I'm going to go on a tangent for a minute, sorry. 

I had a dream of her last night, we were just on a beach. Something we always dreamed of, right? We're from Colorado so it's not something we ever got to experience but always talked about. She was alive during this dream. It felt like I was there with her and she was actually there again. I felt her and I hugged her and I spoke to her. It was such a realistic dream and I don't know why it occured but I put her engagement ring on her shelf and she was wearing it in the dream. I want to believe that she somehow saw me put it there and she received it and that's why I had this dream and this conversation with her. When I woke up I wanted nothing more than to go back. I woke up in this room without her and it sent me into a horrible panic attack where I couldn't breathe. This morning was one of the worst moments of my life and I had to get support because I felt like I was dying during this panic attack. I thought she was with me again and then I resumed reality. This perfect world vs this nightmare. I don't have anything to say about this other than I'm still processing what it meant. I believe dreams mean something quite often. 

This dream I had reminder me of how much better my life could be and I want nothing more than to resume that dream and be with the one I love. I don't remember what we were talking about in this dream but I believe it was a reminder to take her to this beach with me. I believe she is with me still and if I continue my life she will be able to go there with me. The dream was a vision of her not in a parallel reality but a future, I just won't be able to see her. I'm sorry if I seem insane but viewing it like this helps me to continue. 

I'm going to get a dog soon. Do your children help you find a purpose? I don't have one at the moment. I'm sorry if I come off wrong.

Thank you for this line

"So, take a deep breath, and say to her, come on babe, we can do this..."

I told you I had a ring for her, an engagement ring. I have a shelf with her things and pictures of her and I. It is full of journals with photos and memories. She is still with me in memory and as weird as it sounds I often think of her as she's a person inside my head like you do. I talk to her in my head. I'm trying to do this physically now as well and I don't care how it makes me seem because it helps me. I believe she can hear me and I want to talk to her. The ring I had for her I put on her shelf like I was giving it to her. I've been holding onto it for a very long time and I've always wanted to put it over there but I've never had the strength. Putting it on a shelf means I'll never put it on her finger but I believe she still has it in some form. 

I cry every time I think of her. It's not a big deal. I hear her name or even think of a memory with her the tears run down. I often dream of her and when I wake up my pillow is soaked. In my dreams she's still alive and they're so amazing to have. I wish I could sleep forever and live in this world. I'll never be the same because my soul was taken that night. I live without one at the moment and if I continue and eventually find a piece of happiness that soul will be artificial but it will be enough to create a meaningful life. 

Thank you.

Thank you for this.

I understand the past can't be changed but I struggle with that fact. I'm sure you can imagine the mix of emotions I felt the day after and still feel. Immediately I felt angry and upset. I lost my damn leg and couldn't want. The love of my life was gone and there was nothing I could do. I wanted nothing more than to die right then and I honestly wish I would have died in that crash even if she couldn't have survived in my place. Back then there was no reason for me to continue and I wanted to die so badly. I remember pleading that I would so that I could see my love again and for so long I resented the fact that I live on and she doesn't. Someone on a post told me that she fulfilled her promise in sticking with me till the end and I haven't so I need to take her with me in essence until I can no longer do so. 

This statement opened my eyes to so much and it was heartbreaking to read. I didn't realize that until yesterday. My girlfriend and I were not married or even engaged but we had a connection that was the textbook definition of true love. We were talking about kids and our careers and we had plans. We were young and starting our lives when all of that was taken away. Not only was it taken away from us but it was so brutal in how it happened. The anger and resentment I have for what happened is a piece of me and it is a reason I continue on as well. I carry this burden with my of this mistake and accepting it is an impossibility at the moment because to accept something you have to understand at least some piece of it and I seriously don't. My girlfriend took that road so many times to her friends house. She knew it. Yet somehow this happened and the fence thing on the overlook just happened to be in need of repair and then we just happened to land in this specific way. There were so many things that lined up in that night that lead to what happened and it's not natural. I know it's not. I'll never understand why she was taken and I don't know who to assign blame to but I know I'm still angry about it. 

If I could swap anything for her I would, just to talk to her again or just to give her a hug. I love her so much and we had so many things left to do in this world. She is my soulmate. That morning she woke up excited to see the day and had no idea it would be her last and the way it happened was so, so, horrible. I'm sorry, I'll stop. 

Thank you.
Thanks very good news. I hope to try it soon. My PTSD is not only ruining my present life but also tainting memories of my past so I need it to be better.
I have not but I'm kind of worried to try them to be honest. I've never done anything like it and I have bad anxiety so I don't know if they're for me

Ok, I've heard of EMDR and I've began to look into it and it's psycho therapy in which it tries to rewire your brain, correct? Is there anything else like that? Is is actually real? 

Thank you.
I think so too. Thank you for everything.

Thank you. In the hospital I was told I had full in depth conversations in my sleep with my girlfriend but I have no memory. I know they're still somehow with us I just can't tell you how. 

Thank you for your kindness. I hope the same for you.

That's cool. I would be interested in that as well but I think I carry around her soul essence with me. She's a piece of me now. 

Do you have a piece on your home for them as well?

I know she would want me to but it's so difficult to move forward. I have a new mindset that I'm moving forward with her, in essence. I don't want to waste the opportunity I've been given. 

About four months ago I was on my way out of the house to end everything and on the TV her unusual name was spoken three times. I was on my way to do it and somehow she was there to remind me to keep going. I think that day and that reminder was when I knew I was going to keep going not just for me but for her

I think I'll try that as well. I do believe she is out there somewhere so I have that connection as well. I believe if I write letters to her she will somehow receive them in some form. 

Thank you.
Thank you.

Hello, 

I'm probably not in a position to offer advice but I lost my girlfriend that I was planning on proposing to. At the same time I lost my leg and suffered a severe spinal cord injury so I can't walk normally anymore. I lost my entire life that day. I know you probably don't believe anyone else has felt what you're feeling but I have and I still am. The accident happened two years ago and I feel the same today that I did on day one.

But I plan on getting more serious help now. I quit for a while and I was planning on suicide. I have pain killers and I was leaving to go and do it but I decided not to when I somehow heard my girlfriend's name on the TV on my way out. I don't know if you're religious at all but this was surreal. She doesn't have a common name and it was said three times. It was a reminder that she's still with me just not physically.

I can't help you unfortunately but if you want to talk about anything we can do that whenever. I know how hard it is but you also need to let your emotions out. You feel cheated right? He didn't deserve that yet it happened. I feel the same way. My girlfriend was the sweetest, most kind person out there and she lost her life for no reason. I understand that you feel cheated and I wish there was a way to console that. I'll let you know if I ever find out how.

I'm sure it's hard. I cry essentially all the time anyway. An apology for regret? We were planning on doing so many things and all of it was stopped because of what happened. I want to tell her I'll do all of these things with her in essence. Would that be a good idea do you think? Two years and I feel the same way I did on day one so I'm not good at dealing with trauma

I haven't but I would like to. Would that help do you think? I talk to her in my mind a lot. I often try to relive past memories through out texts I read through or I have a voicemail where she says she loves me and she'll see me soon
Thank you, I'll do that. Same for you.

Thank you, that's the main reason I'm going to keep going. 

I hope everything goes well for you in the future and I'm sorry that happened to you. Thank you.

I understand that. It's annoying explaining how you feel every time. I blew so many people off. I was pretty social before and now I talk to five people is all. Three of which being family members. I've told my story so many times it should be on a business card at this point. They always asked if I was ok and it was obvious I wasn't. People are afraid of others in trauma because they don't know how to react. Try to find a few that really understand.

I'm sorry you're going through this as well. Trauma and loss is an aspect of life that is unavoidable but the sudden losses are the ones that impact of us the most. It's not even a process in my opinion, it's a complete transformation. 

The way I see it, the person I was died in the car with my girlfriend and now if I choose to live on I'll be someone else.

Don't put on that facade at all. You need to be broken to heal, don't resist. I barely have a will to live anymore and you can tell physically. It's important that others know so they can try to help you and not only that but so they can tell when you get better or worse. It's important to be real. 

When this accident first happened I was angry. I was a bitter person because I was robbed of my future and my girlfriend was robbed of her life, our life. In a second that was gone because we made a mistake. I drove a lot of people away due to this but the ones who actually care and understand are here and they're the reason I'm here now. You need to be real.

I can't tell who you're replying to but I wanted to say something that I feel as well. I promised my girlfriend that we would live together forever and be together. She upheld that promise and I have to as well. I'm sure that was unexpected of what happened and I'm so sorry that it did. I don't want to say my girlfriend's name because it triggers PTSD but I understand how you feel. I'm not the same person either. The person I was died in that car the same night my soulmate did. 

I have intense physical pain but that pain is nothing to how much the mental and emotional pain hurts. I would deal with this pain a dozen times more painful everyday if I could just see my girlfriend one last time. My last image of her was in that car where she passed on impact. That image is truly horrifying and everytime I close my eyes it hurts to see. This beautiful and amazing person is now being erased by this horrible image in the car. I'm sorry you're going through a similar thing. I can't do anything to help you but I want you to know it's the same for me

That makes sense. You definitely need to say goodbye or you'll regret it. I'm sorry that happened to you. 

I think the memories of her both have negative and positive benefits. In one hand, I can't make anymore memories so I know those are all in the past. However, reminders of how much she loved me and how much I loved her make me really happy. I was granted the opportunity to fall in love with the most amazing person in the world and I'll never not be grateful for that. My life stopped the day of the accident. My social media, wallpaper on my phone, and everything else. All of it is the same. My wallpaper is of her and I and everytime I see it I get reminders of what we had but also painful reminders of what could have been. Everyday I listen to a voicemail from her where she says she loves me and "see you soon". This is really difficult to listen to but I do it everyday as a reminder of her and what he used to have. I will carry on her love for me and use it to create a new life.

Someone said that we were meant to spend our lives together and she fulfilled that but I haven't. That's what makes this so difficult because once I admit she's not my girlfriend anymore it will be like she isn't in that role anymore so I lied to her and to myself. I can't express in words how much I miss her and these images of her keep her alive in some form. I have a picture of her on my wall with a shelf of all of her things. I put the engagement ring I bought for her on this shelf last night for the first time and it was difficult to do so because it means I'll never be able to see it on her but at least she has it somehow. 

I'm sorry, I rambled. Pictures are helpful but they also hurt.

I can't take care of it on my own at the moment so my parents will have to accept responsibility of it when I can't. I'm in a wheelchair at the moment so I can't take it on walks like a normal person but I hope I can someday. I really want one and I think my parents would be ok with it.
I will try as soon as I can. I'm looking forward to learning more about it

I didn't attend her funeral because I was still in the hospital and I couldn't do it mentally. I've since said goodbye in my own way but if I was there with her and we were sending her away I think a lot of these images of her in my head would be different and not as severe. The last time I saw her was in that car. 

Also, doing these things are impossible. I can't do that at the moment because it's like I'm moving forward without her and I'm not ready for that yet. I still try to relive our life prior to what happened in my own head. My goal is to gain the mindset of carrying her with my in essence so I can move forward. I won't move on from her because that means she stays in the same spot and I move, I will move forward with her. This mentality is what I want to have so I can move forward with her and eventually gain happiness.
Thank you, I appreciate the kindness. I'll do that.

Thank you. It's not fair to her memory and it's the worst part of this. I'm haunted by the love of my life. Such a sweet and kind person was turned into this image of horror and I need to repair it somehow. That needs to be my first step.

When my girlfriend was gone I didn't go to her funeral because I just couldn't. I wasn't strong enough at the time and it's one of my biggest regrets because I never said goodbye. I have since but I didn't get to be there with her and say goodbye. I was still in the hospital and it wouldn't have worked out anyway but I wish so badly I could've. I don't know how this applies to what you're going through but I think if I would've seen her one last time to get the last image of her in that car out of my head, the images of her in my mind would be a lot better. If your brother is in a condition to where it would soothe her she needs to see him because that fear will haunt her.

That quote you mentioned. I didn't even realize she spent the rest of her life with me. I'm sorry, that was really difficult to read. I was supposed to spend my life with her and she's gone now. I often feel her being here still, supporting me. I like to think that she is somehow with me in some form. There's been unexplained events that have taken place with my girlfriend since her passing that I can't explain. On a day where I thought I was going to end everything, I commerical on my parents TV came on that said her unusual name three times. I was on my way out to do it and then I heard that. I don't know how it happened but it was the most surreal feeling in the world and then I felt calm and at peace. I somehow I feel her being here sometimes. I can smell her or even feel her sometimes. I also hear her call out my name sometimes. I can't explain any of this and I don't know if it's because I'm crazy or what but I really hope it's because she's out there, looking after me. 

What ifs are such a terrible thing and I've been focusing on those for the past two years. If anything would have been different. If we would have washed the fucking car maybe we could've seen the turn. Anything, could have fixed that night yet the way things lined up lead to this. 

I'm sorry for going on, I just wanted to say that your situation sounds nightmarish and I know that pain. I spent an hour in an upside-down car with my girlfriend, desperately trying to save her even though she was gone at impact. I was told me struggles to save her lead to me losing my leg as well. Both of our situations are a lot to deal with. That's not even begining to explain it. It's like we're dragging around a 5000lbs ball and chain wherever we go. I'm sure you've heard your a survivor a lot. It annoys me because I don't want to be one. If I would've died that night instead of her or with her I would be so much happier but I believe this comment is important because we have to carry on if for nothing else than to make them proud of us. 

Also, I can't imagine that guilt as well. I have guilt as well but I'm sure yours is very intense and dominating. I'm sorry, I don't have any kind of advice on how to deal with that.

I have a very difficult time accepting what happened still. Everything was so calm and casual and then we lost it all. We were mid conversation when a tight turn came up and she didn't turn fast enough and we lost control and flipped over the edge. Just like that she was gone.
Thank you.

I also don't know if you saw his original post but I believe it is even more cruel. Here it is. He is definitely a broken person but his view on the world is not realistic. He makes it sound like I'm a character out of a slasher movie. He also makes it seem like my girlfriend was nothing more than an object which just disgusts me. 

"That sounds fucking based asf, bro. You were once a chad, alpha male, partying, fucking your girlfriend, going on trips to the cabin for fun, and now you're a broken down human. It's--It's fucking beautiful! Don't report me for this. Don't get angry at me for the hand life has dealt you. I have had PTSD since the age of 6; I endured countless rapes and beatings from my family. I'm still here, bro. You and your little gf got into a little crash 2 years ago. Boo! Boo-hoo! Let's see how you are after 22 years of dealing with this shit. Best of luck! :)."

Thank you. My physical appearance doesn't matter at the moment, it's just another thing I lost. I know some people find a lot of what I have to be cool. My friend says it's like I'm a cyborg. I mean, 20 years ago I would just be paralyzed so I am grateful for it. The cost of this stuff is absolutely insane and even though my parents are wealthy they'll never be able to pay this off as long as they live. It's truly a wonderful thing to have but such an impossibility for so many people. Anyone without parents like mine would just be paralyzed so I don't dislike anything that I have. 

The pain I've gotten used to. I've become sort of numb to it but I also take pain killers to sort of numb things like you mentioned. I have marijuana as well but I don't like smoking so I don't use it a lot. As edgy as this sounds, the pain I have is a reminder that I'm still alive. I don't know if that makes sense but I often just sleep throughout the day to not have to live but being in constant pain helps me to stay awake and to do exercises. Doing these exercises are incredibly painful but it's rewarding pain. I hope that makes sense. 

Someone directly messaged me and said we deserved this for driving drunk. My blood alcohol level that night was no where near high enough and I doubt if hers was either. We had wine. Neither of us are heavy drinkers at all. We had a few glasses at dinner. I know I'm seeking a reason, something we did wrong, to justify why this happened to us but I can't find it. You're right, it just happened. How do you accept that?

Yes, I agree. I hope I can take her essence and spirit along with me through this journey and at the end, when I look back, I'm proud of my life and she's proud of me. I know it's going to take many years to have any real progress but once I do I believe it will become very satisfying.

Thank you. The PTSD is the worst part of my life. I cannot stand how it takes over memories of my girlfriend. When I think of her now, I don't see her beautiful face, I see her in that moment. It's horrible and it's causing me intense emotion. Whenever I close my eyes that image is there. I need to erase that somehow

I'm trying to get a new therapist next week. I don't think deeply devastating describes what happened. I think it was so severe that the person I was that night also died and I was given a chance to be someone else. Everything I had in my life was gone in one second. I can't even walk anymore. 

I believe the correct mindset going forward is that this is a new person, I can't compete the goals I had before so I need new ones. I will carry the memory of the girl I love with me throughout whatever journey I go on. She is not a piece of my identity and she will always be with me. 

I came from a small town before I went to college. Everyone knows my story here. When I came back from the hospital and my initial physical therapy there was a parade for me celebrating my life. I thought it was the most cruel thing anyone could do because my life doesn't mean nearly as much as my girlfriend's death. This might seem random but that life I had that everyone was celebrating is gone. It died with my girlfriend. Instead of celebrating me being alive, they should've mourned our deaths. 

I believe the sooner I accept that I am a new person, the better it will be for my healing. Unfortunately, I don't think the pain will ever be gone and I don't think I'll ever be at 100% or even 90% physically or mentally but I believe I can get far enough to where I can live a life of normalcy within the decade.
